frequency_question: How often do bilateral water treaties with visible advance renewal signaling proceed to signed renewal before expiration?
membership_rule: Includes any formal bilateral water-sharing treaty that reached a scheduled expiration or renewal milestone between 1980 and the present, where preliminary joint hydrological or diplomatic committees were convened prior to expiration. Excludes unilateral declarations or cases terminated by military conflict.

cases.name: US-Canada Columbia River Treaty regime extensions/modifications
India-Pakistan Indus Waters Treaty continuous implementation/interim talks
Senegal River Basin Development Organization (OMVS) convention renewals
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase II supplemental agreements

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named cases; representative of formal transboundary water treaty renewals with prior institutional signaling.
known_gaps: Excludes minor unrecorded local basin pacts; focuses on major national-level river treaties.
skeleton: 6 historical transboundary water treaty renewal cycles with active pre-expiration institutional signaling observed, all resulting in successful formal extension or renewal agreements.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 observed comparable instances with precursor signals
validity_reason: International water law norms and state dependency on established river basin architectures evolve slowly over decades.
